Data files and analyses for Franchak, McGee, & Blanch "Adapting the coordination of eyes and head for task-specific visual exploration in the context of locomotion"

Files tagged "LSS1" correspond to Study 1 (Eyes only), "LSS2" corresponds to Study 2 (eyes, head, and gaze)

There are 4 R scripts.
1) Calibration error reports summary statistics for the calibration error for both Study 1 and Study 2
2) lss1_summary_analyses reports t-tests for spread and walking GPS data for Study 1
3) lss2_summary_analyses reports LMMs (eye vs head) for spread and t-tests for walking GPS data for Study 2
4) lss2_peak_analyses reports the head contribution analysis

Each R script produces the figures used in the publication.[exit code: 0]

library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)

#Study 1 Calibration Errors

incl <- read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS1.csv", na = "NaN")
incl <- filter(incl, id != 35) #Bad posttest eye tracking accuracy

ds <- read_csv("/data/calibration_LSS1.csv", na = "NaN")
ds <- mutate(ds, id = factor(Participant))

#Remove participants who weren't in the analysis
ds <- filter(ds, id %in% incl$id)

#Wide to long

  summarise(head_prop = mean(head_prop), na.rm = T) %>%
